reasons.mette_soerensen: the lower-case, ASCII-transliterated tag IS caught by GLiNER (config/gliner.json threshold 0.65, 'person name' label scores 0.74-0.89 on this bare tag with no surrounding context) — this is the asserted Danish pass-2 recall win.
reasons.Mette: bare 'Mette' is only asserted under pass2 (not plain expected.absent) because the 'mette_soerensen' tag above is a case-insensitive substring match for 'mette' and is only closed by GLiNER, not by Presidio alone. The filename-embedded leak this name used to be blamed on ('faktura_MetteSørensen.pdf', no surrounding spaces) is now closed for both passes by filename tokenization (src/policy/filename.ts): the stem is split into 'faktura Mette Sørensen' before detection, so Presidio alone already redacts the embedded name — see 'Sørensen' in expected.absent, which is asserted under pass1 alone precisely because it is NOT also a substring of the transliterated tag.
